description:
Side-by-side facts for 2 to 4 slugs, mixing AI build tools, agent harnesses and Agent Toolbox entries.

Use when: the user is choosing between specific tools (e.g. Cursor vs Claude Code vs Lovable). For an open-ended pick based on an idea, use recommend_stack.

Behavior: Read-only. For each slug: official pricing with checked date and source, free tier, lowest stated $/mo, apps on Vibe Shipped (count, verified, stated revenue total/median, top apps with links), licence, interface, GitHub stars, and MCP/subagents/headless/sandboxing support. null means not stated. Returns isError (bad_input) if fewer than 2 slugs resolve.

Example: {"tools":["claude-code","openai-codex-cli","aider"]}

tools.description: 2-4 slugs from list_tools, list_harnesses or list_agent_tools.

name: compare_tools
title: Compare AI build tools and harnesses
